basic_details.job_title: Delhi University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Delhi University has notified 1 vacancy for the post of JRF on a contractual basis, purely co-terminus with the project terminating in Sep 2027. Applicants for the JRF post must hold an MSc in any branch of life sciences OR B.S. (4 years programme) / Integrated BS-MS/ BPharm/ MBBS/ BE/BTech Biotechnology or equivalent degree in any branch of Life Sciences, with 55% marks, along with NET or GATE qualification. The remuneration offered is Rs. 37,000 plus HRA p.m., with selection based on an interview. Eligible candidates should apply through the offline application process by submitting a plain

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 28 years on the date of application. Age relaxation is applicable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates.

qualification.details: MSc in any branch of life sciences OR B.S. (4 years programme) / Integrated BS-MS/ BPharm/ MBBS/ BE/BTech Biotechnology or equivalent degree in any branch of Life Sciences, with 55% marks. Candidates must also be NET or GATE qualified.

how_to_apply: Prepare your application on plain paper including your bio-data and e-mail address for correspondence.
Attach copies of self-attested marksheets and relevant certificates supporting your qualifications.
Send the completed application by post or hand delivery to Prof. Swati Saha, Department of Microbiology, University of Delhi South Campus, Benito Juarez Road, New Delhi-110021.
Ensure your application reaches the undersigned on or before 4th November 2026.

28 years on date of application (with relaxation for reserved categories)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications and age limits specified for the Junior Research Fellow position in the CSIR-funded project. MSc in any branch of life sciences OR B.S. (4 years programme) / Integrated BS-MS/ BPharm/ MBBS/ BE/BTech Biotechnology or equivalent degree in any branch of Life Sciences, with 55% marks. Candidates must also be NET or GATE qualified. Candidates with experience in Microbiology lab work will be preferred. The upper age limit is 28 years on the date of application. Age relaxation is applicable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive consolidated emoluments of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA per month. The appointment is purely on a contractual basis and is co-terminus with the CSIR-funded project, which terminates in September 2027.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Delhi University JRF
content_sections.text: Prepare your application on plain paper including your bio-data and e-mail address for correspondence. Attach copies of self-attested marksheets and relevant certificates supporting your qualifications. Send the completed application by post or hand delivery to Prof. Swati Saha, Department of Microbiology, University of Delhi South Campus, Benito Juarez Road, New Delhi-110021. Ensure your application reaches the undersigned on or before 4th November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the required criteria will be called for an interview. The notification does not mention any written examination stages.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Delhi University JRF post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is purely on a contractual basis and is co-terminus with the CSIR-funded project, which terminates in September 2027.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid on top of the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate receives emoluments of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is available up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications for this JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates who have experience in Microbiology lab work will be preferred for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must submit a plain paper application along with bio-data (including e-mail) and copies of self-attested marksheets and relevant certificates.
